integrity: All formulas use the explicitly stated unnormalized Fourier transform. The complete directional classification is proved analytically; numerical diagnostics are finite crosschecks and are not a proof of the unbounded assertions.
scientific_limitations: Planar even-integer exponents only; no claim about the global convexity or finite-volume behavior of extended Fourier-mean sets, or about uniformity in the exponent tending to infinity. Classical finite-type decay and elementary endpoint asymptotics are prior tools; no independent priority or mathematical audit established.
title: Four axial Fourier-mean singularities and exact critical residues of planar Fermat balls
